panels.description: Target >= 70%. From pre-aggregated route_daily_stats (implausible sessions already excluded).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  CASE WHEN SUM(navigations_completed + navigations_abandoned) > 0
    THEN SUM(navigations_completed)::float / SUM(navigations_completed + navigations_abandoned) * 100
    ELSE 0
  END AS "completion_rate"
FROM analytics.route_daily_stats
WHERE $__timeFilter(date)

panels.title: Guest Completion Rate

panels.description: North star metric. Retention-window only (navigation_sessions purged after 365 days).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS "completed_arrivals"
FROM analytics.navigation_sessions
WHERE outcome = 'completed'
  AND plausibility = 'plausible'
  AND $__timeFilter(started_at)

panels.title: Plausible Completed Arrivals

panels.description: Distinct route owners with at least one access in the selected period.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT owner_id) AS "active_hosts"
FROM analytics.route_daily_stats
WHERE access_count > 0
  AND $__timeFilter(date)

panels.title: Active Hosts

panels.description: Navigator-first route creations / total route creations. Viral loop signal.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  CASE WHEN SUM(routes_created) > 0
    THEN SUM(routes_created_navigator_first)::float / SUM(routes_created) * 100
    ELSE 0
  END AS "loop_rate"
FROM analytics.platform_daily_stats
WHERE $__timeFilter(date)

panels.title: Conversion Loop Rate

targets.rawSql:
SELECT date AS time,
  users_created AS "Created",
  users_registered AS "Registered",
  users_deleted AS "Deleted"
FROM analytics.platform_daily_stats
WHERE $__timeFilter(date)
ORDER BY date

SELECT date AS time,
  routes_created AS "Created",
  routes_published AS "Published",
  routes_deleted AS "Deleted"
FROM analytics.platform_daily_stats
WHERE $__timeFilter(date)
ORDER BY date

panels.description: Routes created by users who had previously navigated someone else's route.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT date AS time,
  routes_created_navigator_first AS "Navigator-First",
  users_created - users_deleted AS "Net Users",
  routes_created - routes_deleted AS "Net Routes"
FROM analytics.platform_daily_stats
WHERE $__timeFilter(date)
ORDER BY date

panels.title: Viral Loop & Net Growth

targets.rawSql:
SELECT date AS time,
  SUM(access_count) AS "Accesses"
FROM analytics.route_daily_stats
WHERE $__timeFilter(date)
GROUP BY date
ORDER BY date

SELECT date AS time,
  SUM(unique_visitors) AS "Unique Visitors"
FROM analytics.route_daily_stats
WHERE $__timeFilter(date)
GROUP BY date
ORDER BY date

SELECT date AS time,
  SUM(anonymous_visitors) AS "Anonymous",
  SUM(registered_visitors) AS "Registered"
FROM analytics.route_daily_stats
WHERE $__timeFilter(date)
GROUP BY date
ORDER BY date

SELECT date AS time,
  SUM(saves) AS "Saves"
FROM analytics.route_daily_stats
WHERE $__timeFilter(date)
GROUP BY date
ORDER BY date

SELECT date AS time,
  SUM(navigations_completed) AS "Completed",
  SUM(navigations_abandoned) AS "Abandoned"
FROM analytics.route_daily_stats
WHERE $__timeFilter(date)
GROUP BY date
ORDER BY date

SELECT date AS time,
  CASE WHEN SUM(navigations_completed + navigations_abandoned) > 0
    THEN SUM(navigations_completed)::float / SUM(navigations_completed + navigations_abandoned) * 100
    ELSE NULL
  END AS "Completion Rate"
FROM analytics.route_daily_stats
WHERE $__timeFilter(date)
GROUP BY date
ORDER BY date

panels.description: Weighted average across all routes (weighted by completed navigations per route).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT date AS time,
  SUM(avg_duration_seconds::bigint * navigations_completed)
    / NULLIF(SUM(navigations_completed), 0) AS "Avg Duration"
FROM analytics.route_daily_stats
WHERE $__timeFilter(date)
GROUP BY date
ORDER BY date

panels.title: Avg Navigation Duration

panels.description: From navigation_sessions directly. Retention-window only (purged after 365 days).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  $__timeGroup(started_at, '1d') AS time,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE plausibility = 'plausible') AS "Plausible",
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE plausibility = 'too_fast_total') AS "Too Fast (Total)",
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE plausibility = 'too_fast_pace') AS "Too Fast (Pace)"
FROM analytics.navigation_sessions
WHERE $__timeFilter(started_at)
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Plausibility Breakdown

panels.description: Top 10 routes by access count in the selected period.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  route_id,
  SUM(access_count) AS access_count,
  SUM(unique_visitors) AS unique_visitors,
  SUM(navigations_completed) AS navigations_completed,
  SUM(navigations_abandoned) AS navigations_abandoned,
  CASE WHEN SUM(navigations_completed + navigations_abandoned) > 0
    THEN ROUND(SUM(navigations_completed)::numeric / SUM(navigations_completed + navigations_abandoned) * 100, 1)
    ELSE 0
  END AS completion_rate
FROM analytics.route_daily_stats
WHERE $__timeFilter(date)
GROUP BY route_id
ORDER BY access_count DESC
LIMIT 10

panels.title: Top 10 Routes by Access Count

panels.description: From analytics.events (retention-window only, purged after 365 days).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE COALESCE(properties->>'source', 'direct') = 'direct') AS "Direct",
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE properties->>'source' = 'qr') AS "QR",
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE properties->>'source' = 'wa') AS "WhatsApp",
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE properties->>'source' = 'airbnb') AS "Airbnb",
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE properties->>'source' = 'email') AS "Email"
FROM analytics.events
WHERE event_type = 'route.accessed'
  AND $__timeFilter(occurred_at)

panels.title: Source Distribution

panels.description: From analytics.events (retention-window only, purged after 365 days).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  $__timeGroup(occurred_at, '1d') AS time,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE COALESCE(properties->>'source', 'direct') = 'direct') AS "Direct",
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE properties->>'source' = 'qr') AS "QR",
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE properties->>'source' = 'wa') AS "WhatsApp",
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE properties->>'source' = 'airbnb') AS "Airbnb",
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE properties->>'source' = 'email') AS "Email"
FROM analytics.events
WHERE event_type = 'route.accessed'
  AND $__timeFilter(occurred_at)
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Source Trends

panels.description: View (metadata only) vs Download (with images for navigation). From analytics.events.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE (properties->>'include_images')::boolean IS TRUE) AS "Download",
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE (properties->>'include_images')::boolean IS NOT TRUE) AS "View"
FROM analytics.events
WHERE event_type = 'route.accessed'
  AND $__timeFilter(occurred_at)
